observations.command_syntax: The generic example second argument is a string and requires quoted numeric slots. An initial bare slot was rejected by BDS before the plugin; documentation now includes quotes. Later console execute-as attempts did not invoke a saved read: one lost quotes in PowerShell, then the preserved-quote command was refused because its sender was not a Player. These are not SDK read attempts.
